fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Moharir 2022 Eligibility Result 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Eligibility Result for the recruitment of Moharir posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 92 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Moharir Recruitment 2022 were accepted from October 29, 2022, to November 18, 2022. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC Moharir Eligibility Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 October 2022
  • Last Date : 18 November 2022
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 18 November 2022
  • Correction Last Date : 25 November 2022
  • Eligibility Result : 12 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download Eligibility Result
  • Download Eligibility Result Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Official Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSSSC Moharir 2022 Eligibility Result 2026?

UPSSSC Moharir 2022 Eligibility Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
